release_notes: v3.8.0 — Unified PC Sources: CineStream now plays MovieBox, PikaShow, NetMirror and HD Streamz through your PC (run 'python unified/server.py --port 8800' on the PC, then set the address in Settings > Sources). Home gains unified Movies/Series rails with instant play; the TV page gains Live TV channels and live Sports events with source filters. Everything else is unchanged: TMDB + Speedrace + MovieIN keep working exactly as before, standalone or with the PC connected.
